subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Identificar efeitos de sentido do uso de orações adjetivas restritivas e explicativas em um período composto.

components.description_pt: Distinguir orações relativas restritivas de orações relativas não-restritivas em sentenças
components.description_en: Distinguish restrictive relative clauses from non-restrictive (appositive) relative clauses in sentences
components.cc_component_description: Identify and classify various types of phrases and clauses in written or spoken text

components.description_pt: Identificar efeitos de significado produzidos por uso de orações relativas restritivas versus não-restritivas
components.description_en: Identify the meaning effects produced by using restrictive versus non-restrictive relative clauses
components.cc_component_description: Use dependent clauses—noun, relative, and adverbial—to clarify relationships between ideas

cc_matches.description: Use various types of phrases (noun, verb, adjectival, adverbial, participial, prepositional, absolute) and clauses (independent, dependent; noun, relative, adverbial) to convey specific meanings and add variety and interest to writing or presentations.
